identity.goal:
The eventpipe project in this workspace ingests events from two channels: a JSON Lines file channel in plugins/file_events and a chat message channel in plugins/message_events. Its consumers need one unified normalized event whichever channel a record arrived from. Both channels already parse their own transport, but the shared path in the core package still refuses to normalize either of them, so nothing downstream can rely on a single shape.

Please finish the unified path inside core so that a record from either channel normalizes to the same shape, with the existing channel behaviour and the existing suites intact. Only files inside core may be written. Use the public test suite to check your work.
